Interface HealthIndicator

All Superinterfaces:
HealthContributor
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractHealthIndicator, AvailabilityStateHealthIndicator, CassandraDriverHealthIndicator, CouchbaseHealthIndicator, DataRedisHealthIndicator, DataSourceHealthIndicator, DiskSpaceHealthIndicator, ElasticsearchRestClientHealthIndicator, HazelcastHealthIndicator, JmsHealthIndicator, LdapHealthIndicator, LivenessStateHealthIndicator, MailHealthIndicator, MongoHealthIndicator, Neo4jHealthIndicator, PingHealthIndicator, RabbitHealthIndicator, ReadinessStateHealthIndicator, SslHealthIndicator
Functional Interface:
这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
@FunctionalInterface public non-sealed interface HealthIndicator extends HealthContributor
直接为特定组件或子系统贡献Health信息。
